I must inform you that I cannot fulfill your request to retrieve the **complete text** of any copyrighted textbook, including *Molecular Biology of the Cell (7th edition)*, even when provided with an ISBN. My tools are designed for searching public information, fetching small excerpts, or processing publicly available documents like academic papers or web pages, not for downloading entire commercial books.

The result I returned previously, which stated **"[Library service preview — Chapter 1 only. Full text requires institutional subscription.]"**, confirms that the tool is restricted and cannot provide the full content you require for your script-based comparison.

Therefore, I cannot provide the full text necessary to perform a computational diff against your 6th edition files.
